tasks.title: Gravity in body axes
tasks.statement: Roll **{phi}°**, pitch **{theta}°**, any yaw. Find the z component of the gravity vector (0, 0, 9.81) in FRD axes (m/s²).
tasks.solution: g_body = R_nbᵀ·g_ned; the z component = g·cos φ·cos θ. Yaw doesn't affect it.

tasks.title: Lateral component
tasks.statement: Roll **{phi}°**, pitch **{theta}°**. Find the y component (right) of the gravity vector in FRD axes (m/s²).
tasks.solution: The third row of R_nb (the third column of R_nbᵀ): (−sin θ, sin φ cos θ, cos φ cos θ)·g.

tasks.title: Angle from a quaternion
tasks.statement: The scalar part of a unit quaternion is w = **{w}**. By what angle (in degrees) does it rotate?
